# duploai Provider





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `duplo_host` (String) Base URL of the DuploCloud AI API (e.g. http://localhost:60021). Required unless set via the DUPLO_HOST or duplo_host env var.
- `duplo_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token for DuploCloud API authentication. Required unless set via the DUPLO_TOKEN or duplo_token env var.
- `http_timeout` (Number) HTTP client timeout in seconds for DuploCloud API calls (default 60). May also be set via the HTTP_TIMEOUT or http_timeout env var (integer seconds only).
- `ssl_no_verify` (Boolean) Disable TLS certificate verification (development only). May also be set via the SSL_NO_VERIFY or ssl_no_verify env var. Accepted values: 1/t/T/TRUE/true/True/0/f/F/FALSE/false/False.
